map.a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R（R 为外接圆半径）。即边与其对角: a/sinA = b/sinB = c/sinC = 2R (R the circumradius). That is, a side is proportional to the sine of its opposite angle.
map.为什么 SSA 会有两解？: Why can SSA have two solutions?
map.因为 sinθ=sin(180°-θ)，给定一边对角后，另一角可能取锐角或补角，: Because sinθ = sin(180° − θ), given one side and its opposite angle the other angle can be acute or its supplement, corresponding to two different triangles (unless excluded by side length constraints).
